title: ...for the Good of the Chosen
redirects: For the Good of the Chosen

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: ...for the Good of the Chosen is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "You want to see the whole picture, but you forget that you're still just a tool. To learn more, you'll have to rise above the situation and forget about the sides of the conflict you're familiar with. Are you sure you're ready for that? Then listen carefully to your next assignment. You must follow the instructions precisely. First, retrieve the object from Container 14 in the Ultra parking garage. To do that, restore power at the power station, then go up to Burger Spot and find the hidden panel in the restroom. Use the card marked #11SR on the panel, then go down to the TerraGroup safe room in the parking garage. It's next to the escalator from OLI and the breach in the parking garage wall. There's a lever inside that will open Container 14. The container itself is in the parking garage beneath IDEA, by the exit toward the power station. Look for the green container marked TerraGroup. Once you've retrieved the suitcase, head downtown. Make your way to the restaurant on the third floor of the Pinewood Hotel. Leave the suitcase on the balcony. After that, send a yellow signal flare near the tram that collapsed underground. And remember: there must be no witnesses. Conduct the operation at night and leave no one alive who could have seen you. When everything is done, return to me."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +30,000 EXP
"If I had told you what was inside, you wouldn't have agreed to this job. But don't worry, there's neither a virus nor radiation inside. You were right about one thing. Black Division has assignments beyond clearing facilities. There are still samples in Tarkov that TerraGroup's closest competitors would need at least ten years to obtain. I won't tell you what they are or what they do. Some things are worth more than the entire city and everyone living in it. People may die, but the gifts must survive into the new world. After Black Division's operation in Tarkov, there will be nothing left to stand in the way of the plan."
